llm_response.reason: The website claims to be the official Stonefly online shop but uses an unrelated domain; there is no evidence it is approved by Stonefly. It advertises high discounts, uses urgency and trust signals (e.g., 'secure purchases 100%'), lacks real company details or transparent contact/payment information, and mimics a legitimate brand—matching multiple scam characteristics, especially impersonation, unrealistic prices, and ambiguous privacy/customer info.
